Create function CDN.WFL_StatusyZrodlowe(@p_Status integer, @p_WDPID integer) returns @tbl_StatZrod table(t_status int) as begin
declare @tabela table(t_status int, t_poziom int, t_statuswynik int)
declare @poz int set @poz = 1
if @p_WDPID = 0 Select @p_WDPID = WDS_WDPID from CDN.Wf_DefStatusy where WDS_ID = @p_Status
insert @tabela select * from ( select WDZ_WDSID as sk_status, @poz as sk_poziom, WDZ_Wynik as sk_Wynik from cdn.WF_DefZadania (NOLOCK) Where WDZ_WDPID = @p_WDPID and WDZ_WSTECZ = 0 and WDZ_Wynik <>0 union Select wdZ_wdsid as sk_status, @poz as sk_poziom, WDK_WDSID as sk_Wynik from cdn.wf_defStatKonc (NOLOCK) join cdn.WF_DefZadania (NOLOCK) on wdk_wdzid = wdz_id Where WDZ_WDPID = @p_WDPID and WDZ_WSTECZ = 0 ) as STATUSYKONCOWE Where sk_Wynik = @p_status
while ( @poz<100 and exists(select T_Status from @tabela where t_Poziom=@Poz) ) begin insert @tabela (t_status, t_poziom, t_statuswynik) select STATKONC.sk_status, STATKONC.sk_poziom, STATKONC.sk_Wynik from ( select WDZ_WDSID as sk_status, @poz+1 as sk_poziom, WDZ_Wynik as sk_Wynik from cdn.WF_DefZadania (NOLOCK) Where WDZ_WDPID = @p_WDPID and WDZ_WSTECZ = 0 and WDZ_Wynik<>0 union Select wdZ_wdsid as sk_status, @poz+1 as sk_poziom, WDK_WDSID as sk_Wynik from cdn.wf_defStatKonc (NOLOCK) join cdn.WF_DefZadania (NOLOCK) on wdk_wdzid = wdz_id Where WDZ_WDPID = @p_WDPID and WDZ_WSTECZ = 0 ) as STATKONC join @tabela on sk_Wynik = t_status and t_POZIOM = @poz where STATKONC.sk_status not in (select T_Status from @tabela) set @poz = @poz + 1 end
insert @tbl_StatZrod (t_status) select distinct t_status from @tabela
return END
